name: Can I live in my home during a major addition project?
description: Living in your home during an addition depends on the project's scope; extensive work affecting critical areas may require temporary relocation.

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a major addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can remain in your home during a major addition project depends on the scope of work and the areas affected. If the addition is extensive and impacts critical living areas like the kitchen or bathrooms, or requires significant structural work, it might be safer and more comfortable to temporarily relocate. Smaller additions, like a single room or a deck, often allow occupants to stay. Hometelligent Inc. assesses each project individually and discusses potential living arrangements with clients early on, considering factors like noise, dust, and utility interruptions.
